rca of the issue: Responsive overflow likely originates from CandidateDetail action controls exceeding container width on smaller breakpoints. Repro: mocked authenticated navigation to /candidates/cand-1 and evaluate documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth at 320/768/1024/1440 => true across all tested widths.
